name: Deore XT GS-guide front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 112 g for the FD-M700-GS lower-inlet clamp assembly with 1 1/8 inch (28.575 mm) band and 27T capacity. This is not the normal 120 g FD-M700 guide.
